title: Read-only cross-project PostgreSQL HTTP gateway audit

source.instrument: Supabase connected SQL tool; net.http_get, installed pg_net
source.source_mutations: No application rows modified; only pg_net request queues and response logs

target.instrument: Source pg_net → target PostgREST over HTTPS using owner-provided sb_secret in HTTP apikey header

drift.classification: telemetry - audit downstream dependencies before deciding whether to migrate

schema_comparison.note: REST OpenAPI can omit non-exposed schemas and roles; missing public API definition != proof the physical table does not exist. A target Postgres schema dump still needed.

content_read_checks.action: MERGE/RECONCILE, never truncate existing target world
DO NOT IMPORT UNTIL target 6 missing columns and auth user mappings restored
DIFFERENT DATA on target; preserve before migration
Check foreign keys and game-world references before insert
Check world and auth FK mapping before insert
Restore table + grants + policy before data
Archive history externally before selective migration

unconfirmed.message: PGRST303 JWT issued at future; transient or clock-skew, retry before inferring emptiness

warnings: Status 200 with sb_secret is confirmed REST-level authorization, not direct PostgreSQL or Supabase Management API access.
Never run source-to-target row transfer before full target backup, schema/ACL/Auth parity, and codex approval; incomplete target schema would silently lose source fields.
Old source and new target contain divergent live rows; no automatic overwrite or truncate.
Counts are from separate requests and are not a transaction-consistent snapshot; rerun after final quiesce/catch-up.
No target data was written by this audit; all requests were GET, no secrets committed.
next_actions: Codex: consume this evidence and preserve target existing world and game-world state, then back up target before writes.
Codex: restore full source schema/private functions/RLS/ACL/Auth references into a staging target; validate 6 missing voxel player columns and revision.
ChatGPT: once target schema is verified, can use authenticated source pg_net as alternative channel for selected PostgREST data-copy in small verified batches without source Postgres password.
For complete database backup/ownership/ACL migration, direct source pg_dump (or an equivalent independently verified export) remains necessary; REST bridge alone is insufficient.
